title: Do NOT spend money
body: I bought a couple of $5.99 coin options that later showed up as $29.99 “clockwise” payments. Just skip the whole app.

title: Unrealistic Cost
body: I gave this app a chance….l purchased a weekly subscription for $19.99, figuring ebooks typical cost anywhere from free to $15, so l would try the app to read complete one book. If l could do that, with watching some bonus ads and checkins everyday, points for reading so long or so many chapters, maybe the app was worth $19.99 for at least one full book that l wanted to read. The over 2,900 coins that l received for the one week subscription with all the extras, got me to about 140 chapters, but not to the end. There are about 35 more. This is not acceptable or sustainable to me, so l am done. Cancelled the weekly subscription and will not finish this book. Vistanovel lost another customer to their own greed.

title: Bait and pay
body: The chapters you get to read hook you in. But then there is no option to watch hundreds of hours of adds to get the next chapter. Instead, they want you to buy coins and pay per chapter. Fly from here!! Be free of this scam!!!!

title: Scam
body: Don’t download. No bonus or rewards. Only way to read is purchase. I downloaded because it said free reading chapters. I didn’t realize it was only the ones I had already read

title: App that doesn’t work
body: The app that doesn’t work. I can’t login, I can’t contact customer service and yet another app that wants to bleed you dry. At least most reading apps let you earn credits. Not this one.

title: Scam
body: Don’t download if you don’t want a subscription plan. I ran into an ad that said free reading

title: Download if you want to pay $100+ for a webnovel
body: Yet another app that charges through the nose for each chapter of every webnovel, each with hundreds of chapters. The library has ebooks. Real publishers sell ebooks for a minute fraction of the cost. Don’t bother with this grift.

title: No opportunities for rewards
body: So few options, I can only read 1-2 chapters of one book a day.

title: Another Paywall
body: Stories are engaging but another scenario where your consistently stuck having to pay potentially hundreds of dollars for a book. Ads max out at 5 and rewards are very limited.

title: Too Many Ads to Watch
body: The story had my interest but once you get to chapter 5 you have to read using coins which require watching many ads. Some of which do not roll into the actual count. I’ll probably skip the story and delete the app

title: vista novel one of the few decent story apps
body: seems decent so far! not a huge fan of ‘coins’ and ‘bonus’ to unlock chapters being SO heavily locked behind a paywall - would love to see the devs add an option to watch ads to unlock chapters!

title: Great Stories but expensive
body: Coin pay walls are too expensive

title: Novels
body: Novels are fast paced and put together. Really good reads
